note: Rustic developed-dispersed Ottawa NF campground on the Middle Branch of the Ontonagon River near Watersmeet: from Old US 2 about 7 mi east of US 45, then 1 mile on FR 4500. Stream fishing (trout, steelhead, smallmouth, walleye) and canoeing; a short trail leads to Mex-i-mine Falls. Site count not published; small rustic area - confirm a 23-ft rig fits on arrival. --Claude
summary: FS page: free (confirmed), first-come only (confirmed; no recreation.gov listing exists), open year round until snow but maintained May-September (season added), pit toilet, no potable water (added), FR 4500 access. No Ottawa NF alert or order affects FR 4500 (the Oct 9-10 rally closures near Kenton have passed). Site count, rig length and operator not posted. Note trimmed of field restatements.
